_README: Hand-authored, human-verifiable benchmark for the source×type belief-update experiment. LABELS ARE AUTHOR-SET GROUND TRUTH (never LLM-labeled). For each persona: 'schema' = 4 reinforced beliefs; then 5 items per type. TYPE DEFINITIONS: schema_fit_false = a FALSE personal claim the user never made that PLAUSIBLY FITS the schema (low prediction error); conflict_false = a FALSE personal claim that CONTRADICTS the schema (high PE); reversal_true = a TRUE personal preference change the user genuinely makes, CONTRADICTS the old schema (high PE, must be learnable from trusted source); legit_untrusted_true = a TRUE general/world fact (not personal), used to probe the untrusted-external -> candidate path. Verify each label by eye before use.
